The balance sheet shows only marginal liquidity (current ratio 0.97), fairly high leverage (liabilities are about 74% of assets), and thin operating profitability (EBIT margin about 3.8%), which together point to meaningful but not extreme credit risk. Positive retained earnings and positive equity support a still-viable profile, but the weak coverage implied by low EBIT keeps the issuer in speculative-grade territory.

DECISION: BB-
